info.name: Pioneer DDJ-1000 (Jog Displays)
info.author: DDJ-1000 jog-display reverse engineering
info.description: HID jog-screen driver for the Pioneer DDJ-1000: streams beat grid, status and overview waveform to the two jog displays. Load this ALONGSIDE the MIDI mapping (Pioneer DDJ-1000), which handles all controls and runs the SysEx handshake that unlocks the unit's HID performance mode. The waveform columns are a placeholder pattern until Mixxx exposes real overview data to controller scripts.
